title: Collections Desk Note: Towing Fees Within Trade-In Shortfall Installments
content:
Which installment of a **Trade-In Agreements** chargeback shortfall carries a towing fee depends on how late the towing fee deduction was posted, counted in calendar days from the pickup date to the posting date of the latest towing fee deduction entry on the agreement.

## Rule

| Posting of the latest towing fee deduction | Today's figure |
|---|---|
| More than 30 days after the pickup date (the towing fee rides with the last installment) | The shortfall less the towing fee deductions, never less than none, divided by the installment count |
| No more than 7 days after the pickup date (the towing fee is collected with today's installment) | The shortfall less the towing fee deductions, never less than none, divided by the installment count, plus the towing fee deductions up to the shortfall |
| Every other case, or no towing fee on the ledger | The shortfall divided evenly by the installment count |

The towing fee deductions are the total of the value deduction entries with the reason towing fee on the agreement.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: shortfall $1500.00, 3 installments, towing fee deductions $149.00)

| Towing posting lag | Today's figure before rounding | Rounded to the cent |
|---|---|---|
| 40 days | $1351.00 divided by 3 | $450.33 |
| 5 days | $1351.00 divided by 3, plus $149.00 | $599.33 |
| 20 days | $1500.00 divided by 3 | $500.00 |
| No towing fee on the ledger | $1500.00 divided by 3 | $500.00 |

With a shortfall of only $100.00 and a towing fee of $149.00 posted 2 days after pickup, in a single installment: the shortfall less the towing fee counts as none, and the towing fee is taken up to the shortfall, so today's figure is $100.00.
